lines.text: A protocol that creates a locked camera capture extension.
The content for the locked camera capture extension.
A read-only, computed configuration for the locked camera capture extension.
A protocol that provides the UI for the locked camera capture extension.
Implement this protocol with the <doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureUIScene>
providing the UI.
A structure that contains the session object and UI to display for the locked camera capture extension.
An object that can request to open the extension's containing app and receives session configuration
updates.
Provided during the initialization of the
<doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureExtensionScene>. Only the system can
initialize this object.
Creates a locked camera capture extension scene.
- Parameter content: The content of the locked camera capture extension using a
<doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureSession>.
The content and behavior of the locked camera capture extension's UI.
The type for this scene’s body.
An object that can request to open the extension's containing app and receives session configuration
updates.
Provided during the initialization of the
<doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureExtensionScene>. Only the system can
initialize this object.
A temporary directory URL inside the extension's data container.
Store captured content during the current `LockedCameraCaptureSession` to this `URL`.
The system copies the contents of this directory to the extension's containing app's data container
when the extension is suspended. The extension's data container is erased once the
system finishes copying the contents. Store all data that needs to be persisted past the lifetime of
the extension process to this directory.
Initiates a request to open the extension's containing app.
The system requests authentication before opening the app, if needed.
- Parameter userActivity: An `NSUserActivity` that contains relevant information
to benefit from universal link support. Use the
<doc:NSUserActivityTypeLockedCameraCapture> activity type to indicate when the app
launches from a locked camera capture extension.

Invalidates the contents of the session contents URL, deleting them. Note this does not remove the contents directory itself. This is useful in case the extension has already ingested its contents via PhotoKit and wishes to not persist any data (but can still use this directory as a working directory to recover from an unexpected termination).
Indicates why launching the extension's containing app failed.
Retrieve the localized description for this error.
A localized message describing what error occurred.
A localized message describing how one might recover from the failure.
A localized message providing "help" text if the user requests help.
Default domain of the error.
The default user-info dictionary.
Returns a Boolean value indicating whether two values are not equal.
Inequality is the inverse of equality. For any values `a` and `b`, `a != b`
implies that `a == b` is `false`.
This is the default implementation of the not-equal-to operator (`!=`)
for any type that conforms to `Equatable`.
- Parameters:
- lhs: A value to compare.
- rhs: Another value to compare.
The domain for errors that can occur when launching the extension's containing app.
An error that the launch failed with an unknown error.
An error that the launch failed because the system didn't find the application.
An error that the launch failed because authentication failed and the device is locked.
An integer value that represents the error code.
A string that describes the error that occurred.
Returns a Boolean value indicating whether two values are equal.
Equality is the inverse of inequality. For any values `a` and `b`,
`a == b` implies that `a != b` is `false`.
- Parameters:
- lhs: A value to compare.
- rhs: Another value to compare.
Hashes the essential components of this value by feeding them into the
given hasher.
Implement this method to conform to the `Hashable` protocol. The
components used for hashing must be the same as the components compared
in your type's `==` operator implementation. Call `hasher.combine(_:)`
with each of these components.
- Important: In your implementation of `hash(into:)`,
don't call `finalize()` on the `hasher` instance provided,
or replace it with a different instance.
Doing so may become a compile-time error in the future.
- Parameter hasher: The hasher to use when combining the components
of this instance.
The hash value.
Hash values are not guaranteed to be equal across different executions of
your program. Do not save hash values to use during a future execution.
- Important: `hashValue` is deprecated as a `Hashable` requirement. To
conform to `Hashable`, implement the `hash(into:)` requirement instead.
The compiler provides an implementation for `hashValue` for you.
An object that provides handling of captured content and transitioning to the extension's containing app.
URLs provided by the <doc:sessionContentUpdates> `AsyncSequence`.
URLs to directories of the current session content available when beginning observation of
<doc:sessionContentUpdates>.
A URL to a directory of added session content.
A URL to a directory of removed session content.
The shared instance of the manager.
An array of URLs that each point to a directory containing captured content.
Content in the URLs is captured during a capture
extension's <doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureSession>. These
directories are located within the capture extension's containing app's data container.
An `AsyncSequence` to process captured content from your capture extension.
Use this to process captured content as soon as it is available after your app launches.
Tells the system that the app no longer needs the directory at the URL and it can be deleted.
The directory at the `URL` contains captured content for a session. Store the captured content
appropriately before calling this method, otherwise the system deletes it.
- Parameter url: A URL from
<doc:LockedCameraCapture/LockedCameraCaptureManager/sessionContentURLs>.
The system ignores other URLs.
Tells the system that the application wants to delay the application launch during a transition between the extension and the application
Tells the system that the application is ready to appear after delaying the appearance during a transition between the extension and the application
